edits.old: For each enumerated subject, identify broader headings using only the proposed `subject` strings. A child heading must itself preserve every restriction of its parent: type, purpose, modifier, action, negation and relationship.
edits.new: For each enumerated subject, derive broader headings by generalizing its meaning without adding restrictions. An item's usual purpose is not a property of every instance: a purpose-qualified heading cannot contain an unrestricted item heading. Compare only the proposed `subject` strings. A child heading must itself preserve every restriction of its parent: type, purpose, modifier, action, negation and relationship.
